shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat-fronted surface
symmetrical bilateral composition about a vertical axis
paired round/oval elements flanking a central axis (eye-like discs)
justification: Both surfaces are bilaterally symmetrical low reliefs featuring paired circular/oval elements set either side of a vertical axis, and both include a small disc motif, but this is a generic correspondence. A depicts a dense all-over foliate/floral scroll design filling a rectangular panel with masklike knotted forms, while B is a monolithic anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and torso bearing sparse incised motifs, so the subject matter and manner of depiction differ fundamentally.
